correctness.rationale: For Fano lines {a,b,a xor b} and the 21 flags, compatible flags are exactly mutually nonincident flags. An independently written exhaustive enumerator checked all 1330 three-flag subsets and 5985 four-flag subsets: exactly 84 compatible triples and no four compatible flags. It built adjacency by two-flag overlap, not using stored verification_output, and found 252 edges, 84 triangles, 84 six-valent vertices, types (collinear/concurrent) of sizes 28,28,28, pairwise BFS distances (252,840,1442,840,112), centrality 28 and detour counts (2492,882,112). The proof in RESULT.md analytically establishes the 3-edge maximum, type counts, and triangles by three completions of each compatible pair. The BFS certificate covers this entire fixed finite graph; it is not an infinite projective-plane claim.
residual_risks: Finite exhaustive verification is restricted to its specified domain.
